name: events not numbered by date
why: Without the date order E1..E4 follow the order the tracks appear in (04-25 first), not the calendar. A text sort alone would pass here: these event names start with their dates.

name: an undated linked event name wins over the dated comment
why: "68th Academy Awards" carries no date, so its track would get no number and no tint.

name: no chip
why: The tint alone; the chip is what tells events apart without colour.

name: badge legend missing
why: The badge keeps its plain-text tooltip only.

name: main event searched like any other
why: The main event's RG is known from the page; searching for it wastes a request.

name: searched again for every hover
why: Without the per-event cache every track of the event costs a search.

name: a hit accepted by score instead of title
why: Terms mode scores 2005 RAH groups 100 for a 1996 event; the first hit must not be taken as the event's group.

name: repaint restarts a failed search
why: The loop the spec caught: a failure retried by its own repaint, forever.

name: hint count ignored
why: The setting caps the closest titles; 0 shows none.

edits.find: hints: rgs.filter(r => r !== hit).slice(0, hintsN).map(r => ({ id: r.id, title: r.title })), detail: '',
edits.replace: hints: rgs.filter(r => r !== hit).map(r => ({ id: r.id, title: r.title })), detail: '',

name: phrase setting ignored
why: The query is always a phrase.

name: artist setting ignored
why: The query is always scoped to the release artist.

name: tooltip setting ignored
why: Off must mean no card and no request. Since the popup engine (org/iframe.org Phase 1) the setting is the "#" source's enabled(), which also keeps the engine's listeners from serving the cells.

name: Alt+click not wired
why: The card cannot be clicked (pointer-events: none); Alt+click is the only way to its target.
